Message.Name: Time Reference Message
Message.Description: The Time Reference message is used to provide a midnight reference point for recipients of the feed.

Field.Name: Midnight Reference
Field.Description: Midnight Eastern Time reference time for subsequent Time messages, expressed as number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Field.Name: Time Reference
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Current Trade Date

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is sent whenever the source time for a unit passes over a second boundary.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day.

Field.Name: Epoch Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Message.Name: Options Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Options Auction Update messages are used to disseminate price and size information and Composite Market bid and offer prices during Opening and Re-Opening (halt) auctions on the Cboe Options Exchange.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction type indicator

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: Collared VMIM price computed on the queuing book only.

Field.Name: Buy Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Buy contracts at the Reference Price and above.

Field.Name: Sell Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Sell contracts at the Reference Price and below.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Collared VMIM price computed on the combined queuing book and the continuous book. Equal to Reference Price for options that do not have a GTH trading session.

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Uncollared VMIM price computed on the queuing book only.

Field.Name: Opening Condition
Field.Description: Opening condition indicator

Field.Name: Composite Market Bid Price
Field.Description: Bid Price of the prevailing Composite Market

Field.Name: Composite Market Offer Price
Field.Description: Offer Price of the prevailing Composite Market.

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Auction Summary messages are used to disseminate the results of an auction. An Opening or Re-Opening Auction Summary message for each symbol is sent at the conclusion of its Opening or Re-Opening auction and represents the Cboe Opening Price.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction type indicator

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Cumulative number of contracts executed during the auction.

Message.Name: Width Update Message
Message.Description: The Width Update message is used to communicate the opening quote width multiplier.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Width Type
Field.Description: Width type indicator

Field.Name: Multiplier
Field.Description: Width multiplier.

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: A Symbol Mapping message is used to map the 6 character multicast feed symbol field to an OSI symbol.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: Symbol condition indicator

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Underlying right padded with spaces.

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for the feed when all the units have shut down.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last timestamp

Message.Name: SOQ Strike Range Update Message
Message.Description: The SOQ Strike Range Update message is only available on the C1 Exchange. This message disseminates the minimum and maximum strike prices of the price range used to calculate the Special Opening Quote (SOQ) on a Volatility Settlement date.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: SOQ Identifier
Field.Description: Dissemination symbol of the final SOQ right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Lower Strike Price
Field.Description: SOQ lower strike price

Field.Name: Upper Strike Price
Field.Description: SOQ upper strike price

Message.Name: Constituent Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: The Constituent Symbol Mapping message is only available on the C1 Exchange. This message is used to communicate which options series (if any) are Constituent Series in a Volatility Settlement Special Opening Quote (SOQ).

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: Symbol condition indicator

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: SOQ Identifier
Field.Description: Dissemination symbol of the final SOQ right padded with spaces.
